content.text: Build tools automate the compilation, testing, packaging, and dependency management of Java/JVM projects. Understanding Maven and Gradle deeply is essential for managing complex multi-module projects, optimizing CI/CD build times, and resolving dependency conflicts in production systems.

items: Maven — Project Object Model, lifecycle phases, dependency management, and multi-module builds
Gradle — Groovy/Kotlin DSL, task graph, incremental builds, and build cache optimization
